# Formspec Locale Specification v2.0 (LLM Reference)

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-spec-artifacts.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Source spec: `specs/locale/locale-spec.md`
Source schema: `schemas/locale.schema.json`

## Bottom Line Up Front

- This document defines Locale 2.0, a sidecar JSON artifact for internationalizing one exact Formspec Definition or App Manifest target.
- A valid Locale 2.0 document requires `$formspecLocale: "2.0"`, `version`, `locale`, `target`, and a `strings` object. `target` names a `definition` or `app` by canonical URL.
- Loaded Locale identity is `(target kind, target URL, normalized locale)`. Regional-to-base fallback stays within that exact target.
- Item strings use `<itemKey>.<property>` with the bare Item key at any depth (`amount.label` for `lineItems[*].amount`); dotted template paths such as `lineItems.amount.label` are not valid keys.
- App-targeted Locale documents may use the closed `$module.x-formspec-surface.shell.*` key family. Every dynamic string uses FEL `{{expression}}` interpolation; processors do not apply a separate `{name}` parser.
- This BLUF is governed by `schemas/locale.schema.json`; generated references expose the canonical schema-defined structure.

## Behavioral Essentials

- Locale Documents are display-only sidecars — they MUST NOT affect data collection, validation logic, or behavioral semantics.
- Locale 2.0 targets one exact Definition or App Manifest through target={kind,url,compatibleVersions?}; loaded identity is the complete target-kind, target-URL, normalized-locale tuple.
- Resolve localized strings using a deterministic target-bounded cascade: regional locale → explicit or base language locale for the same target → that target's inline or runtime default. Fallback never crosses target identity.
- String keys use dot-delimited paths (itemKey.property) to target specific localizable properties; unmatched keys are silently ignored.
- Surface shell strings use the closed $module.x-formspec-surface.shell.<SurfaceStringKey> family one-for-one with the runtime inventory.
- FEL interpolation via {{expression}} syntax is the only authored template language and is evaluated at render time against the key-specific read-only context; broken expressions fall back to the raw template string with a diagnostic.

## Conformance Essentials

- A conforming Locale 2.0 document must include $formspecLocale='2.0', version, locale, target, and strings; targetDefinition is rejected rather than translated.
- Processors MUST perform case-insensitive BCP 47 tag comparison and SHOULD normalize to lowercase language with title-case region.
- Processors MUST reject duplicate complete target-and-locale tuples, unknown Surface shell key suffixes, and cross-target fallback.
- Processors MUST detect circular fallback chains within one target and terminate the cascade with a warning rather than looping.
- Single-brace strings such as {name} remain literal; processors do not run the retired Surface-only replacement parser.
